name: cr601_2h_a_discarded_card_is_not_also_mana
why: CR 118.3, 601.2h: one card can't pay two costs: with 2 life Bitter Triumph's only form is the discard, and the only card to discard is the Simian Spirit Guide the {1} would need, so it isn't offered (a mulligan to two makes the hand; seven of the deck's eight cards hold both)
